node.label: mucopolysaccharidosis type 9
node.definition: An autosomal recessive lysosomal storage disease caused by mutation(s) in the HYAL1 gene, encoding hyaluronidase-1. It is characterized by short stature and hyaluronidase deficiency.

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)
